name: codexline-events
description: Streams supported Codex lifecycle events to the local Codexline companion.

interface.shortDescription: Live tools, agents, plans, approvals, and compaction events.
interface.longDescription: A local-only event adapter for Codexline. It forwards supported lifecycle hook payloads to the active companion process and is inert when Codexline is not running.
interface.defaultPrompt: Show Codexline event adapter status and setup guidance.
